# lifesim-3i2: Genome carries a hidden memory sensitivity; Memory reads it
task · P3 · auto, lane:sim

## Description
## Goal
The genome carries a hidden memory sensitivity and Memory starts from it.
## Context
memory.R22 (accepted): sensitivity is a per-character genome value, inherited from rung 6, shown only in the cheat inspector. Today Memory holds sensitivity in its own save part (MemoryRef.Sensitivity, default knob content/memories/knobs.yaml#sensitivity.default, set by SetSensitivity) because Genome (src/Sim.Core/Modules/CharacterCreator/Genome.cs: Visible, Recessive, Seeds) has no keyed hidden value. Add a hidden sensitivity to Genome and change Memories.Start to read it. See design/decisions/2026-10-13-memory-traces-in-code.md. The creator writes the knob default for now (today's behaviour kept); how the value is drawn is a separate design task. Record the genome representation as a session decision.
## Done when
- A character made by the creator carries a sensitivity in its genome, saved with it (household file format bumped, schema updated).
- Memory starts from it; the use case for R22 sets it through the genome.
- just check green.
## Touches
src/Sim.Core/Modules/CharacterCreator/Genome.cs, GenomeWriter.cs, src/Sim.Core/Modules/Memory/Memories.cs, src/Sim.Core/Saves/ (household format), content/schema/, tests/usecases/, design/decisions/.
## Out of scope
how the value is drawn (design task "Decide how the creator assigns a lifer memory sensitivity"), inheritance (rung 6), the cheat inspector view.

## Acceptance criteria
A character made by the creator carries a sensitivity in its genome, saved with it; Memory starts from it; the use case for R22 sets it through the genome.
